EconomyMines.HelpTitle: How does the Mine Report work?
EconomyMines.HelpPurpose: Compute your province's weekly mine report: production, upkeep and miners' salary, ready to share on the forum.
EconomyMines.HelpOverview: Two ways to use this chest: a quick daily report to post on the forum (paste today's text, then click straight on "Format today's report", no calculation, no week to pick), or a priced weekly report (steps below).
EconomyMines.HelpStep1: Pick the week you want to process with the arrows at the top of the page — only days within that specific week will be taken into account, even if your pastes contain others.
EconomyMines.HelpStep2: In the game, open the "Mine management" tab and copy the whole page text, starting from "Maintenance costs increase..." through to the end of the page.
EconomyMines.HelpStep3: Paste that text into the Mines Commissioner's Log. You can paste the interface several times to complete the data for the selected week: each new paste fills in the data already known, without ever erasing anything.
EconomyMines.HelpStep4: Click "Generate weekly report": it computes the production value, upkeep and net (after salary) for the selected week.
EconomyMines.WeekIncompleteWarning: Incomplete week: {count}/7 days covered ({monday} to {sunday}). The report is still computed from the data available.
EconomyMines.NoDataError: No data recognized. Check that you pasted the game's text correctly.
EconomyMines.CopyError: Could not copy to clipboard (permission denied by the browser?).

Cookies.Preamble: This page describes how the officedescoffres.creacube.be site uses cookies and local storage technologies in your browser. It complements the {privacyLink}, which covers personal data associated with your account.

Section1.Title: 1. Reminder: non-official tool
Section1.Content: Office des Coffres is a non-official community tool for the game Renaissance Kingdoms, developed voluntarily. It is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Celsius Online, the game's publisher.

Section3.Title: 3. What we store in your browser
Section3.Intro: No third-party HTTP cookies are set on this site. We use two browser storage mechanisms, both limited to what is strictly necessary:

Preferences.Title: Local storage — Preferences
Preferences.Purpose: remember your interface choices (dark/light theme, French/English language), your default character, and your last inputs in public tools (Watch, Mines Report).
Preferences.Data: your chosen theme, language, default character ID, cache of texts you have pasted into public tools.
Preferences.Retention: until you clear site data from your browser, or withdraw your consent via the cookies banner.
Preferences.LegalBasis: your consent (GDPR art. 6.1.a, French Data Protection Act art. 82).
Preferences.IfDecline: the site works normally, but your preferences and drafts are not remembered between visits.

Tokens.Title: Local storage — Authentication tokens
Tokens.Purpose: maintain your connection to your user account during your session.
Tokens.Data: an access token (short-lived) and a refresh token (longer-lived if you check "Stay logged in").
Tokens.Retention: access token valid for 15 minutes; refresh token valid for 12 hours by default or 30 days if you checked "Stay logged in".
Tokens.LegalBasis: these tokens are strictly necessary for the service requested (your login). As such, they are exempt from consent under article 82 of the French Data Protection Act, but documented here for transparency.
Tokens.IfDecline: you cannot stay logged in — you would need to re-authenticate on each action, making usage impractical.

Section4.Title: 4. What we don't do
Items: No audience measurement or behavioral analytics cookies (Google Analytics, Matomo, Plausible, etc.).
No data sharing with third-party services for commercial purposes.
No sale of information to anyone.

Section5.Title: 5. Technical note: HTTP cookies vs local storage
Section5.Content: Technically, this site does not use "cookies" in the classic HTTP sense. It uses the browser's localStorage mechanism to store preferences and authentication tokens. This distinction is purely technical — from the perspective of the CNIL and GDPR, both mechanisms fall under the same information and consent obligations, and are treated identically in this policy. The term "cookies" is used in the consent banner for general understanding.

Section6.Title: 6. Distinction between anonymous visitor and registered user
Section6.Anonymous: Anonymous visitor (no account): only the Preferences storage can be enabled, based on your choice in the cookies banner. Nothing else is stored.
Section6.Registered: Registered user with an account: authentication tokens are added to local storage when you log in. Your account data itself (characters, account preferences) is stored on our server, not in your browser — see {privacyLink}.

Section7.Title: 7. Your rights
Section7.Withdraw: Withdraw consent at any time via the "Manage preferences" button in the navigation. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal.
Section7.Erase: Erase stored data: clearing your site data from your browser (Settings → Privacy → Clear data) instantly removes everything stored on the browser side.
Section7.Complaint: Right to lodge a complaint with the {cnilLink} if you consider that the processing of your data does not comply with GDPR.

Section8.Title: 8. Changes to this policy
Section8.Content: This policy may be modified to reflect technical or regulatory changes. Any substantial modification will be signaled by a re-opening of the consent banner on your next visit. The date of last modification is indicated at the bottom of this page.

Section9.Title: 9. Contact
Section9.Content: For any question related to this policy or the exercise of your rights, contact: [TO BE FILLED BY GREG: contact email — same as the data controller in §2, or different depending on your choice]

Privacy.Preamble: This page describes how the officedescoffres.creacube.be site processes the personal data associated with your user account. It complements the {cookiesLink}, which covers local storage in your browser.

Section1.Title: 1. Reminder: non-official tool
Section1.Content: Office des Coffres is a non-official community tool for the game Renaissance Kingdoms, developed voluntarily. It is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Celsius Online, the game's publisher.

Section3.Title: 3. When you create an account
Section3.Intro: Creating a user account is optional. The site can be browsed freely without an account, with access to public tools (Watch, Mines Report, calendar). A free account unlocks additional features tied to your game history (Customs, Mines Registry — upcoming modules).
Section3.AccountFieldsIntro: To create an account, only two pieces of information are requested:

AccountFields.Label: Email address
AccountFields.Text: used for login, identity verification on first access, and service-related communication (password reset, important notifications).

AccountFields.Label: Password
AccountFields.Text: stored securely (hashed with bcrypt), never in plain text.

Section3.CharacterFieldsIntro: You can then add one or more Renaissance Kingdoms characters to your account:

CharacterFields.Label: Character pseudonym
CharacterFields.Text: as it appears in the game.

CharacterFields.Label: City of residence
CharacterFields.Text: selected from the official reference of kingdoms/provinces/cities.

CharacterFields.Label: Validation status
CharacterFields.Text: indicates whether the character has been verified as legitimate by an administrator.

Section4.Title: 4. What we do with your data

Rows.Purpose: Authenticate you, contact you for service needs
Verify your identity on each login
Operate private tools tied to your account (upcoming: Customs, Mines Registry)
Verify that you have access to the declared address
Access control to administration functions reserved for the site editor

Section4.NoCommercialUse: No personal data is used for commercial, advertising, aggregate statistics, or profiling purposes.

Section5.Title: 5. How long we keep your data
Section5.ActiveAccount: Active account: your data is kept as long as your account exists.
Section5.InactiveAccount: Inactive account: after [TO BE FILLED BY GREG: duration to choose, e.g. "2 years"] without login, your account may be automatically deleted, following a notice email to the declared address.
Section5.DeletedAccount: Deleted account: immediate and definitive deletion of the associated personal data (email, hashed password, linked characters). No partial anonymization, no archive.
Section5.TechnicalLogs: Technical logs (server access, application errors): kept for a maximum of 12 months for incident investigation and service security, then erased.

Section6.Title: 6. Who can access your data
Section6.Editor: The site editor (see §2), for technical administration and user support — access limited to the strict minimum.
Section6.NoOneElse: No one else. No sharing, no resale, no transmission to third parties, including Celsius Online (publisher of Renaissance Kingdoms), except for a duly notified judicial requisition.
Section6.Hosting: Data is hosted on servers located in the European Union (host: [TO BE FILLED BY GREG: host name — e.g. "O2Switch, France"]).

Section7.Title: 7. Your GDPR rights
Section7.Intro: In accordance with articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the following rights over your personal data at any time:

Rights.Label: Right of access
Rights.Text: obtain confirmation that your data is being processed and receive a copy.

Rights.Label: Right to rectification
Rights.Text: correct inaccurate data about you (email and pseudonym editable from your Profile; other fields on request).

Rights.Label: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
Rights.Text: request the deletion of your account and all associated data.

Rights.Label: Right to restriction of processing
Rights.Text: request the suspension of processing of your data in certain situations.

Rights.Label: Right to object
Rights.Text: object to the processing of your data based on legitimate interest.

Rights.Label: Right to data portability
Rights.Text: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON), to transmit it to another service.

Section7.Complaint: Right to lodge a complaint with the {cnilLink} if you consider that the processing of your data does not comply with GDPR.
Section7.HowToExercise: To exercise these rights: contact {email}. A response will be provided within a maximum of one month. Account deletion can also be requested directly from your Profile (upcoming feature — for now, please email).

Section8.Title: 8. Security of your data
Section8.Intro: We implement the following technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
Measures: Passwords hashed via bcrypt (never stored in plain text, impossible to reconstruct).
OAuth 2.0 token authentication (Laravel Passport): short-lived access token (15 minutes) and separate refresh token (12 hours or 30 days with "Stay logged in").
Refresh token rotation on each use, with reuse detection (possible compromise signal).
Mandatory email verification before first login.
Administrator access restricted to a single role, manually assigned by the editor.
Section8.BreachNotice: No system being infallible, in the event of a security breach affecting your personal data, you will be notified in accordance with article 34 of the GDPR.

Section9.Title: 9. Cookies and local storage
Section9.Content: Browser-side storage (technical cookies, localStorage) is covered by a dedicated policy: {cookiesLink}. It notably describes the authentication tokens stored in your browser to maintain your login session.

Section10.Title: 10. Changes to this policy
Section10.Content: This policy may be modified to reflect technical or regulatory changes. Any substantial modification will be notified to you by email at the declared address. The date of last modification is indicated at the bottom of this page.

Section11.Content: For any question related to this policy or the exercise of your rights: {email}
